description: Elastic ($m_Y=m_p$) and proton-dissociative ($1<m_Y<10$ GeV) $\rho^0(770)$ photoproduction off protons, in bins of the photon-proton energy $W$. The cross section is defined as the integral of the relativistic Breit Wigner resonance in the dipion mass over the range $2m_\pi<m_{\pi\pi}<1.53$ GeV. The tabulated cross sections are $\gamma p$ cross sections but can be converted to $ep$ cross sections using the effective photon flux $\Phi_{\gamma/e}$.
location: data of Table 7 and Figure 10-11 of arxiv:2005.14471
name: Table 7, RHO photoproduction cross section wrt W
